messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "increase total daily dose by 50 mg every 3 days as tolerated"
set: ["increase total daily dose by 50 mg every 3 days as tolerated", "increase dosage by 25 mg every 3 days", "increase dosage as tolerated", "increase dose to 7 mg once daily after 30 days on 3 mg dose", "50 mg orally per day every 3 to 4 days", "5 mg every 2 to 3 days", "increase by 850 mg every 2 weeks", "total daily doses above 50 mg are not recommended", "3 mg once daily", "50 mg (one 50 mg tablet) every 12 hours", "start with 3 mg once daily for 30 days", "dosage may be titrated upward every 3 days", "dose may go up to 50 mg once a day if tolerated", "50 mg for the first 3 days of the dosing cycle", "can be increased by 100 mg every 5 days if needed", "increase by 500 mg increments weekly"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
